lead: A hostile case's memory ending cannot be reached with `Core\Arr::append` in a loop.
body: Each call copies the array, so growing to the 256 MiB ceiling one entry at a time is quadratic, and 200,000 appends of a one-element array did not finish inside 200 s — well past any `timeout-ms`. Seed the list with the values the attack is about and double it with `Core\Arr::appendAll($kept, $kept)`, which reaches the ceiling in under a second.
